definition: ν = z_condition − z_reference, an unidentified abstract nuisance contrast; not an anatomical neuron or injected current.
full_domain: all finite real ν for each marginal contrast; no finite evidence-derived bound
shared_state_consistency: z is indexed by run/cue/source state. Contrasts sharing a state share that latent value. Marginal sign sets do not assert every Cartesian-product sign combination is jointly realizable.
matched_context_restriction: ν=0 because the two counterfactual terms hold nuisance equal, not because biology has zero alternative input
unit: abstract dimensionless output coordinate; no mV interpretation
